phát sinh từ tài sản FVTPL tăng 98,5 tỷ đồng, các khoản tăng này chưa đủ bù đắp phần giảm |
của lãi bán tài sản tai chính. |

từ đầu tư nắm giữ đến ngày đáo han, lưu ký chứng khoán và bảo lãnh, đại lý phát hanh có tăng
nhưng tỷ trọng đóng góp còn hạn chế.

175,83 tỷ đồng.

: nam 2026.
Vốn điều lệ ban đầu của Công ty là 300.000.000.000 VND và đã được bổ sung trong từng thời kỳ theo các |
giấy phép điều chỉnh. Tại ngày 30 tháng 09 năm 2026, tổng vốn điêu lệ của Công ty là 25.727.885.330.000

In accordance with Circular No. 96/2020/TT-BTC dated 16 November 2020 on information
¬ disclosure on the securities market, VIX provides the following explanation of the changes in its
financial results for Q3 2026 (the reporting period) compared with Q3 2025 (the comparative period):

1. In Q3 2026, the Company’s total operating revenue amounted to VND 2,047.6 billion, down
VND 1,174.23 billion, or 36.4%, compared with Q3 2025.
The decrease was primarily due to lower revenue from trading financial assets at fair value
through profit or loss 7 VTPL), with gains on sales of financial assets falling by VND 1,285.7
billion year on year. Although revaluation gains on FVTPL financial assets rose by VND 66.3
billion and dividends and interest income from FVTPL assets increased by VND 98.5 billion,
, these increases were insufficient to offset the decline in gains on sales of financial assets.
In addition, securities brokerage revenue decreased by VND 54.7 billion. Revenue from held-
to-maturity investments, securities custody, underwriting and issuance agency services
increased, but made only a limited contribution to total revenue.
2. Total operating expenses in Q3 2026 amounted to VND 1,744.4 billion, up VND 1,693.9
billion year on year.
The increase arose primarily from trading FVTPL financial assets. Specifically, expenses from
downward revaluation of FVTPL financial assets amounted to VND 1,362.8 billion, compared
with a negative amount of VND 188.7 billion in the same period last year; losses on sales of |
FVTPL financial assets also increased by VND 175.83 billion. : |

These changes significantly increased operating expenses for the period, directly affecting the
. Company’s financial results.

THE COMPANY
VIX Securities Joint Stock Company (“the Company”) is a joint stock company established under the
Law on Enterprise in Vietnam, the License for establishment and operation No. 70/UBCK-GP dated
10 December 2007 issued by the State Securities Commission of Vietnam with the original name of
Vincom Securities Joint Stock Company. The Company officially changed its name to VEX Securities
Joint Stock Company under License No.67/GPDC-UBCK issued by the State Securities Commission
of Vietnam on 20 October 2020. The latest adjustment license of the license for establishment and
operation of a securities company No.103/GPDC-UBCK issued by the State Securities Commission
of Vietnam on 10 September 2026.
The Company’s initial charter capital was VND 300,000,000,000 and has been supplemented from
time to time in accordance with amended licenses. As at 30 September 2026, the Company’s total
charter capital was VND 25,727,885,330,000.
The Company’s Head Office is located at 22" floor, No. 52 Le Dai Hanh Street, Hai Ba Trung Ward,
Hanoi, Vietnam.
The Company’s main activities include securities brokerage service, proprietary trading, securities
underwriting and securities investment consulting service.
